```{r,echo=F}
options(scipen=999)
pn = function(c,d){
    d = d[c!=0]
    c = c[c!=0]
    p = paste0("{",c,"}x^{",d,"}",collapse="+")
    p = gsub("x^{0}","",p,fixed=T)
    p = gsub("x^{1}","x",p,fixed=T)
    p = gsub("+{-","-{",p,fixed=T)
    p = gsub("+{1}x","+x",p,fixed=T)
    p = gsub("-{1}x","-x",p,fixed=T)
    p = gsub("{-1}x","-x",p,fixed=T)
    p = gsub("{1}x","x",p,fixed=T)
    p = gsub("{","",p,fixed=T)
    p = gsub("}","",p,fixed=T)
    return(p)
}

while(T){
    r = sample(c(-10:-1,1:10),3)
    a = 1
    b = -sum(r)
    c = r[1]*r[2]+r[2]*r[3]+r[1]*r[3]
    d = -r[1]*r[2]*r[3]
    A = a
    B = b+r[1]*a
    C = c+r[1]*(b+r[1]*a)
    prob = paste0("Factor $",pn(c(a,b,c,d),3:0),"$.")
    hint = paste0("Hint, $",pn(c(1,-r[1]),1:0),"$ is a factor.")
    solution = paste0("$(",pn(c(1,-r[1]),1:0),")(",pn(c(1,-r[2]),1:0),")(",pn(c(1,-r[3]),1:0),")$")
    if(min(abs(c(a,b,c,d,A,B,C)))>0 && max(abs(c(a,b,c,d,A,B,C)))<1000){break}
}

cubic = pn(c(a,b,c,d),3:0)

rch = -10:10

ach = character()
for(i in 1:length(rch)){
    ach = c(ach,pn(c(1,-rch[i]),1:0))
}
f1 = pn(c(1,-r[1]),1:0)
f2 = pn(c(1,-r[2]),1:0)
f3 = pn(c(1,-r[3]),1:0)

sol1 = f1==ach
sol2 = f2==ach
sol3 = f3==ach
sol = sol1+sol2+sol3
sol = paste0(1*(sol!=0),collapse="")

al = paste0("* $",ach,"$",collapse="\n")

```



Question
========

The cubic polynomial $`r cubic`$ can be factored fully into a product of 3 distinct linear-binomial factors. Find the three factors.

*Hint: one of those factors is $`r pn(c(1,-r[1]),1:0)`$.*

Answerlist
--------

`r al`


Solution
========

Start with the given polynomial.

$$`r cubic`$$

Divide $`r cubic`$ by $`r pn(c(1,-r[1]),1:0)`$ to get $`r pn(c(A,B,C),2:0)`$. Thus, the cubic polynomial can be written in semi-factored form as the product of the linear and quadratic factors.

$$(`r pn(c(1,-r[1]),1:0)`)\cdot(`r pn(c(A,B,C),2:0)`)$$

Factor the quadratic by finding two numbers with a product of `r C` and a sum of `r B`.


$$(`r pn(c(1,-r[1]),1:0)`)\cdot(`r pn(c(1,-r[2]),1:0)`)\cdot(`r pn(c(1,-r[3]),1:0)`)$$
